          What daily users are saying

          Protect how you look, feel, and perform

          From your skin and eyes to your heart and brain, astaxanthin’s benefits reach your whole body, each one backed by human clinical studies.‡

          Nature’s most potent antioxidant

          Astaxanthin is the red pigment microalgae make to protect themselves from intense sun. In your body, one molecule spans the entire cell membrane, guarding it inside and out, where most antioxidants protect only one side.
